gaps.explanation: Statement (p9, Exhibit IV proprietary funds): Total Receipts 594,459.93 + NONOPERATING RECEIPTS Water Grant 135,000.00 (Water Fund) + Interest earned 128.12 = 729,588.05. The proprietary budget-and-actual schedule (p15) prints the same Water Fund 135,000.00 under NONOPERATING RECEIPTS (DISBURSEMENTS) as 'Bond Proceeds' (Water Fund nonoperating net 135,128.12, same as p9). detail[80] records it with section 'other financing' (outside_printed_total), so it is missing from detail revenue: 594,588.05 = 594,459.93 + 128.12. The schedule prints it among (nonoperating) receipts, so per the 2026-11-06 ruling (bond proceeds follow the printed section; printed among receipts -> receipt line 'Bond Proceeds') the line belongs in section revenue. Fix: remove detail[80] and add the same printed row as a revenue line. 594,588.05 + 135,000.00 = 729,588.05 = statement total. Note: p9 calls the money 'Water Grant' (JSON receipt, intergovernmental/state aid) while p15 calls it 'Bond Proceeds'; the report's own conflict stays in decision_needed for the user; the added line keeps the schedule's printed label.
